16.. FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 ANNUAL BUDGET WORKSHOP #3 (CITY COUNCIL). CM Landers gave a brief staff report. 

Director Rahmani gave a power point presentation on Budget Recommendations 1-5 (get them from his powerpoint)

CM noted that she does not recommend cuts to Public Works 2 and 3 - on Page 4 of staff report. 

She noted that she may be come back with request for training monies in the event she find that more money is needed. 

AR inquired about IT budget allocation and the proposed centralized training under human resources. CM Landers addressed his question. 

Discussion ensued about Public Works Building and Roadway Maintenance. 

LDH inquired about Summer Youth Program - she is opposed to approving budget allocations for summer youth program. 

AR noted his support of continuing the summer youth program on a limited basis.
